name: Create and edit a note
steps: Create a note with a title and body
Save and confirm its date is shown
expected: The edited note remains visible with its date.

name: Delete a note
steps: Delete it using its delete control
expected: The note is removed from the list.

name: Create and complete a task
steps: Open Tasks from the bottom navigation
Add a task with a date and time
expected: The task shows its date/time and completed state.

name: Delete a task
expected: The task is removed from the list.
